SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Fail-open claim is limited to the snapshot-build/setRootOutput catch; it does not promise all SDK/tracing failures are harmless.
Langfuse returns raw observations. The ops reader validates/decode provenance and can reject incomplete or ambiguous records.
Rendering is parent-owned; fragment containment is recursive in this model, with no crossing XML coordinates supplied.
No retired RagTrace persistence is present in this focused workflow/ops path.
